name: MoYu Super AoLong AI 3x3 (8-Magnet Ball-Core + MagLev + UV)
description: The MoYu Super AoLong AI 3x3 (8-Magnet Ball-Core + MagLev + UV) brings back the legendary AoLong series with cutting-edge design and tuning innovations, providing a next-level solving experience for today's cubers. This modern reimagining features an upgraded elasticity adjustment system that lets you fine-tune the cube's feel with a single button, offering eight unique levels of elasticity.
features: Revolutionary 20-magnet ball-core for enhanced stability and alignment (8-magnet ball-core for AI version)
100 factory-installed magnets for consistent, precise turning (88 for AI version)
Selectable matte or UV-coated finishes for your preferred grip and appearance
Also available as an AI Smart Cube with UV coating for connected cubing
